scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy --branch main
scripts.preview:pages: bun run build && wrangler pages dev
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p src && tsc -p src/service-worker && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p server
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:server && bun run test:browser
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun lint && bun run fmt:check
scripts.generate:proto: mkdir -p shared/generated src/generated && protoc -I shared --es_out=shared/generated --es_opt=target=ts shared/instrument.proto shared/song.proto && protoc -I src -I shared --es_out=src/generated --es_opt=target=ts,map_imports=song.proto:@slopemp/song/generated,map_imports=instrument.proto:@slopemp/song/generated src/asset-favorites.proto src/clipboard.proto && protoc -I src --es_out=src/generated --es_opt=target=ts src/preferences.proto
